comments.value: Can you share the LLM prompt you've used to generate the text if applicable, to better understand the intent behind your feature request?

details:
When an avatar is removed by moderation today, the files are deleted and nobody has a path back. I'd like to propose a middle state.

The proposal:

1. Instead of deleting, set the avatar to paused — unusable, invisible to everyone, files preserved.

2. The uploader chooses: take it down themselves, or submit it for review.

3. If it clears review, the same content can't be re-reported.

Why this matters at scale: most people wear public avatars from creators they follow, not avatars they made. One removal takes that avatar away from everyone wearing it simultaneously. Those users didn't upload it, can't correct it, and have no appeal path because they aren't the uploader. A paused state with a correction path fixes it for all of them at once instead of leaving hundreds of people with nothing.

Why part 1 is cheap: per VRChat's API documentation, an avatar is never fully deleted — its ReleaseStatus is set to "hidden" and the AvatarID is permanently reserved. The hidden state already exists. Preserving the linked files alongside it is a change to an existing flow, not a new system.

Why part 3 matters: report-bombing has been a documented complaint for years, with no way to stop the same avatar being flagged repeatedly. Hashing cleared content so identical uploads aren't re-flagged closes that without a human looking twice.

On review capacity — a manual queue doesn't scale to millions of avatars, and I'm not asking it to. Some ways to bound it: limit review requests per uploader per month, restrict them to established accounts, or offer review only after a first paused action rather than on every flag. Public avatars with many users could be prioritized, since those removals affect the most people.

Right now a removal is permanent, silent about what triggered it, and hits everyone wearing the avatar. Any one of those being fixed would help. A paused state fixes the first and makes the other two survivable.
title: Add a paused state for moderated avatars, with optional re-review
